Image 2 is the APPROVED STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference only, depicting Guan Yu: do NOT copy Guan Yu's identity or his weapon for this different character. Match its simple chunky chibi pixel art, stepped dark navy outlines, crisp square clusters, flat limited shading and compact horizontal silhouette. Draw a NEW dynamic three-quarter waist-up preparation pose, clear expressive eyes and visible gripping hands, readable immediately without text. Entire weapon, hands, ornaments and effects must be contained with at least 5% transparent margin on ALL four sides. A composed waist-up cut-in with a natural angular lower robe silhouette, not a rectangular crop. No horse or mount. Transparent RGBA background, no text or letters anywhere, no panel, no frame, no labels, no UI, no gradients, no scenic background, no photorealism, no smooth anime, no giant aura or dragon. Use at most 1-2 small sharp pixel glints, no particle cloud. A single cohesive image, not a sprite sheet or multiple poses. Preserve weapon design from Image 1; don't add weapons that do not fit the character. Character: 초선. Pose: Diao Chan sweeps her pink silk sleeve and open fan in a graceful precise casting gesture, hair ornaments retained, two small petal-shaped accents only. ANATOMY CHECK: fingers wrap only a grip/wooden shaft. For a sword: pommel, short dark grip, gold guard, straight silver blade must share ONE continuous axis; no hand ever touches the metal blade. Single-sword characters hold the sword in ONE hand with the other hand clearly separate. Polearms have a long non-bladed shaft held below the metal head. Bows have a coherent string with one nocked arrow. Do NOT copy Guan Yu's two-handed polearm grip for swords, fans or other weapons. Keep reference head-to-body proportions; this is not a uniform head enlargement. No fuzzy exterior glow.
